description: A static call gives an expanded final argument without its expansion
notes: The spec says a static call returns the argument expressions, but not what becomes of the ... after the final one, which changes how the arguments map to parameters. hashicorp/hcl's hcl.StaticCall has no field for it, and FunctionCallExpr.ExprCall (hclsyntax/expression.go) gives the final argument like the others.
